blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: This work presents the task and results of the CHiME-9 challenge for Enhancing Conversations to address Hearing Impairment. The challenge considers the scenario of four-party conversations in a noisy, cafeteria-style environment with interfering speech sources and sound effects. Participants are provided with audio recordings made with Meta Aria glasses and hearing aid microphones, and clean speech samples of the conversation participants. The task is to extract the speech of the conversation partners from the noisy multi-channel recordings with the goal of improving the intelligibility and quality of the speech, evaluated using objective metrics and subjective listening tests. This paper reviews submissions from seven teams and ranks them on a combination of subjective intelligibility and quality. Results show that while the objective metrics do not reflect listener performance, the top systems were able to make substantial improvements over the challenge baseline in both intelligibility and quality ratings.
blocks.zh: 这项工作介绍了CHiME-9挑战的任务和成果,即加强对话以解决听力障碍。 挑战在于,在一种吵闹的、食堂式的环境中,四方对话的情况会干扰言论来源和声音效果。 向与会者提供了用Meta Aria眼镜和助听麦克风制作的录音,以及对话参与者的干净发言样本。 任务是从吵闹的多频道录音中提取对话伙伴的语音,目的是提高语音的通晓性和质量,使用客观的度量衡和主观的听觉测试来评价. 本文审查7支队伍提交的材料,并按主观知觉和质量相结合的方式排列其等级. 结果表明,虽然目标衡量标准没有反映听众的绩效,但顶级系统能够在不显眼和质量评级两方面大大改进挑战基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: While existing AHD provide a substantial benefit in some scenarios, there are still many scenarios in which they face serious challenges. In particular, this issue is found in conversations in dynamic, noisy environments such as cafes, restaurants and pubs. Their limited effectiveness makes it harder for those with hearing impairments to comfortably socialise, leading to a poorer quality of life.
blocks.zh: 虽然现有的人类发展方案在某些设想中提供了很大的好处,但仍有许多设想方案使他们面临严重挑战。 特别是在咖啡馆、餐馆和酒吧等充满活力和吵闹的环境里的对话中发现了这一问题。 由于效力有限,听力障碍者难以舒适地社交,导致生活质量下降。

blocks.en: In recent years, research into using NN to enhance speech for AHD has shown great potential for improving the experience of hearing-impaired individuals. This, coupled with recent advances in low-power NN hardware, has ushered in a new era for AHD , with AI-enabled HA now available to the general public.
blocks.zh: 近年来,关于利用NN增强AHD的语音的研究显示,在改善听障者的经验方面有很大的潜力. 再加上最近NN低功率硬件的进步,

blocks.en: Enhancing speech in scenarios that are both acoustically and socially complex presents a variety of challenges for NN -based techniques. Real-world situations often contain dynamic background noise, including interfering speech, making it especially difficult for algorithms to effectively enhance the speech of a desired speaker. Further, multi-party conversations tend to have very rapid turn-taking and overlapping speech [ 9 , 8 ] , where the active speaker is frequently changing, and there can also be multiple active speakers at any one time.
blocks.zh: 在声学和社会复杂的情景中加强言论对基于NN的技术提出了各种挑战。 现实世界的情况往往包含动态背景噪声,包括干扰语音,使得算法特别难以有效增强想要的演讲者的语音. 此外,多党派对话往往有非常迅速的交替和重叠的演讲[9,8],其中活跃的演讲者经常在变化,同时在任何时间也可以有多个活跃的演讲者.

blocks.en: The CHiME-9 ECHI ( ECHI ) challenge focuses on this scenario, providing researchers with the ECHI dataset [ 22 ] (cf. Section 2 ), which captures real conversations in a cafeteria-style noisy environment. Teams participating in the challenge developed NN systems to enhance speech in conversations specifically for AHD (Aria glasses or HA ). Systems submitted to the challenge were evaluated using objective metrics, but also by a set of subjective listening tests designed to assess the speech intelligibility and quality of their systems. This paper presents the challenge task and the final results from both objective and subjective evaluation.
blocks.zh: CHiME-9 ECHI(ECHI)的挑战侧重于这一情景,为研究人员提供了ECHI数据集[22](参见第2节),它捕捉了在自助餐厅风格的吵闹环境中的真实对话. 参与挑战的团队开发了NN系统,以加强专为AHD(Aria眼镜或HA)的对话中的语音. 接受挑战的系统通过客观的衡量标准加以评价,但也通过一系列主观的监听测试加以评价,这些测试旨在评估其系统的语音智能性和质量。 本文件介绍了挑战任务以及客观和主观评估的最终结果。

blocks.en: While the challenge is now complete, the ECHI dataset is available for future research † † www.huggingface.co/datasets/CHiME9-ECHI/CHiME9-ECHI , and the data obtained through the listening tests will be made public in the near future.
blocks.zh: 虽然挑战已经完成,但ECHI数据集可供今后研究使用,____www.huggingface.co/datasets/CHiME9-ECHI/CHiME9-ECHI,通过监听测试获得的数据将在近期公布。

blocks.en: The rest of the paper is structured as follows: a brief overview of the provided data is given in Section 2 , the challenge task, rules and baseline are described in Section 3 , the submitted systems are covered in Section 4 , the challenge results for objective and subjective assessment are presented in Section 5 and discussed in Section 6 and conclusions from the challenge are presented in Section 7 .
blocks.zh: 本文其余部分的结构如下:第2节简要概述所提供的数据;第3节介绍挑战任务、规则和基线;第4节介绍所提交的系统;第5节介绍客观和主观评估的挑战结果;第6节讨论;第7节介绍挑战的结论。

blocks.en: 2 Data
blocks.zh: 2 数据

blocks.en: Participants in the challenge were provided with the CHiME-9 ECHI dataset [ 22 ] , which contains real recordings of four-party conversations in a noisy environment. The dataset consists of 29 29 hours of audio, recorded over 48 48 sessions, with a total of 190 190 unique participants, and contains noisy, multi-channel audio, CT ( CT ) microphone audio, reference audio (for NN training), and clean speech samples for each participant.
blocks.zh: 向参加挑战的与会者提供了CHiME-9 ECHI数据集[22],其中包含在吵闹环境中对四方对话的真实录音. 数据集由29个29小时的音频组成,共录制了48个48个课,共有190个独特的参与者,包含吵闹的多频道音频,CT(CT)麦克风音频,参考音频(用于NN培训),以及每个参与者的清洁语音样本.

blocks.en: 2.1 Recording Scenario
blocks.zh: 2.1 记录设想

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : The recording setup for the ECHI dataset. Note that this diagram is not drawn to scale.
blocks.zh: 图1:ECHI数据集的录制设置. 注意此图没有绘制成比例 。

blocks.en: Groups of four participants would be seated around a table in the centre of the room, surrounded by 18 18 loudspeakers playing background noise, as illustrated by Figure 1 (not to scale). Recording sessions lasted 36 36 minutes, with background noise playing at different levels throughout the session. In each session, one person would be wearing Aria glasses and another (always different from the Aria wearer) would be wearing a pair of HA shells.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,四人小组将坐在会议室中心的桌子周围,周围有18个18个扬声器,播放背景噪音。 录音会持续3636分钟,在整个会议期间,背景噪音在不同级别播放。 在每场比赛中,一人将佩戴阿里亚眼镜,另一人(始终不同于阿里亚佩戴者)将佩戴一对HA炮弹.

blocks.en: The four loudspeakers in the corners of the room played back ambient noise sourced from the WHAM! dataset [ 28 ] . The remaining 14 14 loudspeakers surrounded the participants, and played back dynamic background noise constructed using speech from the LibriSpeech dataset [ 15 ] and the EARS dataset [ 16 ] , and sound effects from FSD50K [ 7 ] . Only sound effects which could reasonably be heard in a cafeteria were included, e.g. coughing, typing and cutlery noises.
blocks.zh: 房间角落的4个扩音器播放了来自WHAM的环境噪音! 数据集 [28]. 剩下的14个14个扬声器包围了参与者,并用LibriSpeech数据集[15]和EARS数据集[16]的语音和FSD50K[7]的音效来播放所构建的动态背景噪声. 仅包括在食堂里可以合理听到的音效,例如咳嗽、打字和餐具噪音。

blocks.en: 2.2 Materials
blocks.zh: 2.2 材料

blocks.en: The noisy audio to be used as input for the algorithms is audio from Aria glasses and HA shells. The Aria glasses record 7 7 -channel audio on the device, and the HA record 4 4 -channel audio through an external soundcard; the HA are worn with one on each ear, so the 4 4 -channel audio is made up of two channels on the left ear and two channels on the right. The Aria glasses and HA are always worn by different participants in each session.
blocks.zh: 用作算法输入的噪音音频是来自阿里亚眼镜和HA贝壳的音频. Aria眼镜在设备上录制了7 7-声道音频,HA记录了4 4-声道音频通过外部音卡;HA穿戴时每耳各有一个声道,因此4 4-声道音频由左耳的两个声道和右耳的两个声道组成. 每届学员都佩戴阿里亚眼镜和HA.

blocks.en: All conversation participants also wore a CT microphone, which captured speech close to the mouth of the wearer at a very high SNR ( SNR ), recorded through the same soundcard as the HA (i.e. sample-synchronous). Reference signals were generated by first applying a NN speech denoiser [ 5 ] to the CT audio, as this still contained some background noise and speech from other conversation partners, followed by a delay-compensation algorithm to account for delays due to time-of-flight and clock drift [ 24 ] between the Aria clock and the soundcard for the CT recordings.
blocks.zh: 所有对话参与者还戴着CT麦克风,在非常高的SNR(SNR)上捕捉到佩戴者口附近的语音,通过与HA(即样本同步)相同的音卡录制. 参考信号是通过首先对CT音频应用NN语音denoiser [5]而生成的,因为这仍然包含一些背景噪声和来自其他对话伙伴的语音,然后是延迟补偿算法,以计入阿里亚时钟与CT录音的音卡之间由于飞行时间和时钟漂移[24]而造成的延迟.

blocks.en: Each conversation participant also recorded a reading of the first paragraph of the rainbow passage [ 6 ] in a quiet environment, as speech enhancement techniques can use a sample of the target speaker’s voice to help extract them from a noisy mixture, e.g. by creating speaker embeddings [ 4 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 每个对话参与者还记录了在安静的环境中对彩虹通道第1段的读数[6],因为增强语音技术可以使用目标发言人声音的样本来帮助从吵闹的混合物中提取出来,例如通过创建扬声器嵌入[4,11].

blocks.en: Motion tracking data was also recorded, which gives the position and orientation of each participant in the conversation. This was used in the generation of the reference signals to estimate time-of-flight, but challenge participants were also able to use it during training of their systems.
blocks.zh: 动议跟踪数据也被记录下来,这给出了对话中每个参与者的位置和方向. 这被用于生成用于估计飞行时间的参考信号,但参与者在系统培训中也能够使用这一参考信号。

blocks.en: Finally, VAD ( VAD ) labels were provided for each conversation participant by applying a NN VAD algorithm to the CT microphones [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 最后,通过对CT麦克风应用NN VAD算法为每个对话参与者提供VAD(VAD)标签[21].

blocks.en: 3 Challenge Task and Baseline
blocks.zh: 3 挑战任务和基线

blocks.en: The challenge task was defined as a MSX ( MSX ) task, where the goal is to extract the speech from the conversation partners using the Aria/ HA recordings and rainbow passages of the conversation partners. Two separate tracks were defined for the Aria glasses and HA ; submitted systems should only process the Aria audio or HA audio at once. Challenge participants were also expected to suppress the wearer’s speech, and could use the rainbow passage of the wearer to this end.
blocks.zh: 挑战任务被定义为MSX(MSX)任务,目标是利用对话伙伴的Aria/HA录音和彩虹通道从对话伙伴那里提取演讲. 为Aria眼镜和HA定义了两个独立的音轨;提交的系统只应同时处理Aria音频或HA音频。 参加挑战的学员们也会压制穿戴者的演讲,并且可以为此利用穿戴者的彩虹通道.

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Subsets
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据子集

blocks.en: The dataset was split into three subsets at the session level: the training subset contains 30 30 sessions ( 18 18 hours), the development subset contains 10 10 sessions ( 6 6 hours), and the evaluation set contains 8 8 sessions ( 4.8 4.8 hours). Each subset was disjoint with respect to the conversation participants and background noise, so no speakers in the training subset would appear in the development or evaluation subsets.
blocks.zh: 数据集在会场一级分为三个子集:培训子集包含30场30场(18小时),开发子集包含10场(6场6小时),评价子集包含8场8场(4.8场4.8小时). 每个子集与对话参与者和背景噪音脱节,因此,培训子集中没有发言者出现在开发或评价子集中。

blocks.en: For the training and development sets, all materials described in Section 2.2 were provided to the challenge participants. For the evaluation set, only the noisy Aria and HA audio and the rainbow passages were made public, as these were the only materials which were supposed to be used by the model.
blocks.zh: 就培训和开发成套材料而言,第2.2节所述的所有材料都提供给了培训参与者。 对于评价集,只有吵闹的Aria和HA音频以及彩虹通道被公之于众,因为这些是模型应该使用的唯一材料.

blocks.en: 3.2 Challenge Rules
blocks.zh: 3.2 质疑规则

blocks.en: The full rules to the challenge can be found on the challenge website † † www.chimechallenge.org/challenges/chime9/task2/index , but a description of the key rules is given below.
blocks.zh: 挑战的全部规则可在挑战网站 QQ www.chimechallenge.org/challenges/chime9/task2/index 上查阅,但对关键规则的说明如下。

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Latency Requirements
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 紧急需要

blocks.en: Given that the fundamental goal of the challenge is to enhance speech using AHD , there was a strict requirement for submitted systems to operate with a 20 20 ms theoretical latency . This means that any submitted system may not use any part of the signal > 20 >20 ms in the future from the current time step, for example, when normalising the audio.
blocks.zh: 鉴于挑战的根本目标是利用AHD加强语音,因此严格要求所提交的系统在20 ms的理论延迟条件下运作。 这意味着,任何提交到的系统今后从当前时间步起,例如在音频正常化时,都不得使用信号 > 20 > 20 ms的任何部分.

blocks.en: This latency is theoretical, as it does not account for any computation time. There is significant variation between the computational power of AHD , so an accurate quantification of how quickly a model can run was not feasible. That said, teams were instructed to report model size and computational complexity in their reports.
blocks.zh: 这种延迟是理论上的,因为它没有计算任何时间。 AHD的计算功率有很大差异,因此准确量化一个模型能够运行多快是不可行的. 尽管如此,已指示各小组在其报告中报告模型的规模和计算的复杂性。

blocks.en: 3.2.2 External Resources
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 外部资源

blocks.en: A whitelist of open-source external resources was provided to the challenge participants, ensuring that teams did not use private resources unavailable to other teams, potentially providing an advantage. Teams were able to request additions to the whitelist until 5 5 months before the challenge submission deadline.
blocks.zh: 向挑战参与者提供了一份开放源外部资源白名单,确保各小组不使用其他小组无法获得的私人资源,从而有可能提供优势。 各小组可以要求加入白名单,直到提交质疑的截止日期前5个月。

blocks.en: 3.3 Baseline
blocks.zh: 3.3 基线

blocks.en: The baseline system for the challenge was a TSX ( TSX ) model with a TF-GridNet backbone [ 11 , 4 , 27 ] . This model only extracts one speaker at a time, so it is applied iteratively with each of the target rainbow passages to extract each speaker.
blocks.zh: 挑战的基线系统是TSX(TSX)型号,具有TF-GridNet主干线[11,4,27]. 这个模型一次只抽取一个扬声器,所以它与每个目标彩虹通道的迭代应用来抽取每个扬声器.

blocks.en: A system diagram for the TSX model is given in Figure 2 . To ensure compliance with the latency rules, components were modified from the original TF-GridNet model [ 27 , 11 ] to make them causal [ 4 ] . This primarily affected the STFT ( STFT ) and GridNet blocks, which use LSTM ( LSTM ) networks and self-attention in the time dimension. For the STFT , the window size was fixed to 8 8 ms, with a hop size of 4 4 ms. The LSTM blocks were fixed to be unidirectional in the time dimension, and masked self-attention was used to prevent look-ahead.
blocks.zh: 图2列出了TSX模型的系统图。 为确保遵守延迟规则,从最初的TF-GridNet模式[27,11]修改了组件,使其成为因果关系[4]. 这主要影响了STFT(STFT)和GridNet块,它们使用LSTM(LSTM)网络和在时间维度上的自我关注. 对STFT来说,窗口大小固定为8个8米,跳动大小为4个4米. LSTM区块在时间维度上被固定为单向的,并使用蒙面的自觉来防止外观-前瞻.

blocks.en: Fig. 2 : System diagram of the baseline TSX network.
blocks.zh: 图2:基线TSX网络的系统图。

blocks.en: The baseline system was trained only using the training subset of the challenge data, with no external resources. The model hyperparameters were tuned using the STOI ( STOI ) scores [ 23 ] on the development subset. The full training parameters can be found in the challenge GitHub repository † † www.github.com/CHiME9-ECHI/CHiME9-ECHI .
blocks.zh: 基准系统只利用挑战数据的培训子集培训,没有外部资源。 模型超参数的调制使用开发子集上的STOI(STOI)分数[23]. GitHub寄存器 www.github.com/CHiME9-ECHI/CHiME9-ECHI 挑战中可找到完整的培训参数。

blocks.en: 4 Submitted Systems
blocks.zh: 4 提交系统

blocks.en: In total, the challenge received submissions from 7 7 different teams, with teams participating in the Aria track, HA track or both; all systems are listed in Table 1 . A wide variety of techniques was employed, with some teams extending the provided baseline and others submitting solutions based on entirely different model architectures.
blocks.zh: 总共收到7个不同小组提交的质疑意见,其中小组参加阿里亚赛道、HA赛道或两者;所有系统均列于表1。 采用了各种各样的技术,一些小组延长了提供的基线,另一些小组则根据完全不同的模型结构提交解决办法。

blocks.en: 4.1 System Design
blocks.zh: 4.1 系统设计

blocks.en: All but one team proposed TSX models to solve the task, with AHU-IEI [ 26 ] opting for an MSX system instead. Eleven [ 29 ] and Waseda-NTT [ 12 ] both introduced an OVS ( OVS ) block to the beginning of the system to remove the speech of the device wearer, with Eleven using the wearer’s rainbow passage for NN -based OVS , and Waseda-NTT estimating null-beamformer coefficients. AHU-IEI only used the target speaker’s rainbow passage as a training target, not using it as input to the model at all. Eleven also used the rainbow passages of the non-target conversation partners to better disambiguate the conversation partners from one another.
blocks.zh: 除一个团队外,所有团队都提出了TSX模型来解决任务,AHU-IEI [26]选择了MSX系统代替. 11[29]和Waseda-NT[12]都引入了一个OVS(OVS)块到系统的开始,以去除设备穿戴者的语音,其中11人使用穿戴者的彩虹通道进行NN-基于OVS的OVS,以及Waseda-NT估算无束系数. AHU-IEI只使用目标扬虹通道作为训练目标,完全没有使用它作为模型的输入. 十一人还利用非目标对话伙伴的彩虹通道,使对话伙伴更好地相互分离.

blocks.en: 4.2 Reference Signals
blocks.zh: 4.2 参考信号

blocks.en: While reference signals for each conversation partner were provided in the dataset [ 22 ] , the AHU-IEI and Waseda-NTT teams decided to produce their own reference signals to better remove leaked background noise/cross-talk and model transmission effects more accurately. AHU-IEI achieved this by training a speech denoiser, using data constructed from the CHiME-9 ECHI CT recordings, while Waseda-NTT used a close-to-distant microphone projection, which uses beamforming to estimate the transmission effects from the CT microphone to the worn device.
blocks.zh: 虽然数据集中为每个对话伙伴提供了参考信号[22],但AHU-IEI和Waseda-NT小组决定制作自己的参考信号,以便更好地去除泄露的背景噪声/交叉对讲和模型传输效果更准确. AHU-IEI通过训练一个语音denoiser,利用CHiME-9 ECHI CT录音中构建的数据实现了这一点,而Waseda-NT则使用近距离麦克风投影,使用束形来估计从CT麦克风到磨损设备的传输效果.

blocks.en: 4.3 Exclusion
blocks.zh: 4.3 不适用情况

blocks.en: During post-submission processing, one team reported generating extra training data with the CHiME-3 dataset [ 1 ] . Under challenge rules, this team could not be included in the final rankings as using non-whitelisted data may confer an advantage relative to compliant systems. However, the challenge organisers felt that the system was scientifically relevant in the wider context of speech enhancement for AHD , and so retained the system in the subjective listening tests.
blocks.zh: 在提交后处理期间,一个小组报告利用CHiME-3数据集生成额外培训数据[1]。 根据质疑规则,这个小组不能列入最后排名,因为使用非白名单数据可能给符合要求的系统带来优势。 然而,挑战组织者认为,该系统在对AHD的语音增强的更广泛的背景下具有科学相关性,因此在主观听力测试中保留了该系统.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Table 1 : The full results table for the CHiME-9 ECHI challenge. The † {}^{\text{\textdagger}} indicates the team excluded from the final challenge rankings ( Section 4.3 ), and * indicates the oracle system from the CT microphones, with the italic objective scores indicating the slightly different objective evaluation. Bold scores indicate the best score of the systems in the official ranking. The Subjective Score is the average of the Subjective Correctness and Subjective Ovr scores, with the latter linearly mapped to the same range as the correctness. Empty rows in the subjective columns indicate teams which were not evaluated in the listening tests. Standard error is provided for the Subjective Score.
blocks.zh: 表1:CHiME-9 ECHI挑战全结果表. QQText\textdagger QQ表示被排除于最终挑战排名(第4.3节)的球队,*表示CT麦克风的甲骨文系统,斜体客观分数表示略微不同的客观评价. 粗体的分数表示系统在官方排名中的最佳分数. 主观分数是主观正确和主观Ovr分数的平均值,后者线性映射到与正确性相同的范围. 主观列中的空行表示监听测试中没有评价的队伍. 为主观分数提供了标准错误。

blocks.en: Systems were evaluated by objective measures of speech intelligibility and speech quality as well as subjective listening tests, presented in Table 1 . The objective measures considered here are the commonly used fwSegSNR ( fwSegSNR ) [ 25 ] , PESQ ( PESQ ) [ 17 ] , and the composite speech quality metrics (CSig, CBak and COvl) [ 13 ] to assess speech quality, as well as the STOI [ 23 ] to assess intelligibility. These metrics are computed with the Versa toolkit [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 系统通过客观的语音知识、语音质量以及主观听力测试来评估,如表1所示。 这里考虑的客观措施是常用的fwSegSNR(fwSegSNR)[25],PESQ(PESQ)[17],以及用于评估语音质量的复合语音质量衡量标准(CSig,CBak和Covl)[13],以及用于评估不显眼性的STOI[23]. 这些指标用Versa工具包计算。

blocks.en: For subjective scoring, listening tests were conducted to assess speech intelligibility and speech quality. For each test, a listening panel of 32 32 native English speakers with self-reported normal hearing was recruited. Due to the limited capacity of listening tests, teams that submitted multiple systems to the challenge were asked for their preferred system to be evaluated subjectively. These teams were provided with their objective scores on the evaluation set to inform their decision. Systems not included in the subjective evaluation have empty rows in the corresponding columns of Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 对于主观评分,进行监听测试,以评估语音的知觉和语音质量. 每次测试都招聘了32名讲英语的本地人,自报正常听力。 由于监听测试能力有限,要求向挑战提交多个系统的团队对其首选系统进行主观评价. 已向这些小组提供了评价组的客观分数,供他们作出决定。 不包括在主观评价中的系统在表1的相应栏中有空行.

blocks.en: For speech intelligibility, listeners were played a short passage ( ∼ 8 \sim 8 s) of the conversation and asked to transcribe the speech of a target speaker from 5 5 s onwards (cued visually) under one-shot listening conditions. Systems were scored on correctness by computing the longest common subsequence between the listener responses and the ground truth, giving percentages in the range [ 0,100 ] [0,100] [ 18 ] . The longest common subsequence rating was chosen over word error rate as it does not penalise insertions; listeners could hear multiple talkers in the audio segments, and so they should not be penalised if they write down speech from the non-target speaker. Each system received 512 512 listener responses.
blocks.zh: 对于语言通晓性,听众被播放谈话的一段短话(QQ 8 \sim 8 s),并要求在一弹的听觉条件下将目标发言人的演讲从5 5 秒(可视化)转录. 系统通过计算听众回复和地面真理之间最长的常见子序列,在正确性上得分,给出了在[0,100] [0,100] [18] 范围内的百分比. 最长的常见子序列评分被选在词错误率之上,因为它不会惩罚插入;听众可以在音频段听到多个说话者的声音,因此如果他们从非目标演讲者那里写下演讲的话,他们就不应该受到惩罚. 每个系统收到了512,512个听众的答复.

blocks.en: Speech quality was evaluated according to the ITU P. 835 835 standard [ 14 ] . This involved listeners hearing 5 5 s segments of audio and rating on three scales: how natural the speech sounded (Sig), how intrusive the background noise was (Bak), and overall quality defined in the context of everyday speech communication (Ovr). These were rated on continuous scales (with range 1 1 - 5 5 ) with Likert-style verbal anchors. Each system received a minimum of 340 340 ratings.
blocks.zh: 根据国际电联第835,835号标准[14]对发言质量进行了评价。 这涉及听众在三个尺度上听取5个5个部分的音频和评分:语音的自然性(Sig),背景噪音的侵扰性(Bak),以及从日常语音交流(Ovr)的角度界定的整体质量. 这些被评为连续尺度(范围为1至5 5),并配有Irikrt风格的口头主播. 每个系统都得到至少340-340的收视率.

blocks.en: Included in the subjective evaluation was an oracle system, which consisted of the summed CT microphone channels for each session. This was included to indicate what might be achievable under near-ideal speaker extraction and to help contextualise the performance of the submitted systems. For the objective evaluation of the CT microphones, metrics were computed using the reference signals without the delay-compensation applied, as this was only applied to account for the time-of-flight from the speaker to the device (Aria glasses or HA ), as indicated by italics in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 主观评价中包括一个甲骨文系统,它由每场会议的CT麦克风综合频道组成。 列入本报告是为了说明在近乎理想的演讲者提取中可以实现哪些目标,并帮助将所提交的系统的绩效按部就班。 对于CT麦克风的客观评价,使用参考信号计算指标时没有采用延迟补偿办法,因为如表1斜体所示,这只用于计算从扬声器到装置(Aria眼镜或HA)的飞行时间。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: All systems were able to make substantial improvements over the baseline systems in at least one of the subjective metrics, with different teams choosing to focus on different approaches to achieve the task. The Subjective Score is the average of the correctness score and the overall quality score (which was linearly mapped from its native range, [ 1 , 5 ] [1,5] , to a percentage in the range [ 0,100 ] [0,100] ).
blocks.zh: 所有系统都能够在至少一个主观衡量标准上大大改进基线系统,不同的小组选择以不同的方法完成任务。 主观分数是正确性分数和整体质量分数的平均值(其线性分布从它的本土范围,[1,5] [1,5],到[0,100] [0,100]的一个百分比).

blocks.en: For the HA track, the winner by Subjective Score was AHU-IEI v1-011, with a Wilcoxon test confirming their improvement over the next best system with strong evidence ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 ). The subjective metrics suggest that this system operated primarily as a denoiser; it scored strongly on the Bak ratings, and while this caused some distortion to the naturalness of the speech, it made a huge difference to the intelligibility compared to other teams, with the next best system 13.78 % 13.78\% behind in the correctness score.
blocks.zh: 对于HA赛道,由主观得分制得分的获胜者是AHU-IEI v1-011,通过威尔科克斯测试,以有力证据证实了他们比次佳系统(p < 0.01 p < 0.01)的改进. 主观的衡量标准表明,这个系统主要是作为德诺瓦人运行的;它在巴克评级上得分很强,虽然这给演讲的自然性造成了一定的扭曲,但与其他球队相比,这个系统对隐形性有很大的区别,在正确性分数中,次佳的系统为13.78%13.78%+++.

blocks.en: The winner of the Aria track is more tightly contested, with both MTEC-Approach2 and SFU-SpeechEnhancer performing well on the speech quality and speech intelligibility scores, respectively. A Wilcoxon test only shows weak evidence that MTEC-Approach2 outperforms SFU-SpeechEnhancer ( p < 0.10 p<0.10 ) according to the Subjective Score, so the ranking cannot be concluded only from this score. However, for the correctness ratings, SFU-SpeechEnhancer’s improvements are also shown to have weak significance ( p < 0.10 p<0.10 ), while on the Ovr quality score, there is strong evidence to suggest that MTEC-Approach2 produces a greater improvement than SFU-SpeechEnhancer ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 ). With this in mind, MTEC-Approach2 is considered the winner of the Aria track.
blocks.zh: 阿里亚赛道的得分比较激烈,MTEC-Approcach2和SFU-SpeechEnhancer分别在语音质量和语音不显眼分数上表现良好. 一项威尔科克斯测试只显示MTEC-Approach2优于SFU-SpeechEnhancer(p < 0.10 p<0.10)的微弱证据,因此排名不能只从这个分数中得出. 然而,对于正确性评分,SFU-SpeechEnhancer的改进也显示意义微弱(p < 0.10 p < 0.10),而在Ovr质量评分上,有强烈的证据表明MTEC-Approach2的改进大于SFU-SpeechEnhancer(p < 0.01 p < 0.01). 考虑到这一点,MTEC-Approach2被认为是阿里亚赛道的冠军.

blocks.en: Interestingly, MTEC-Approach2 took the converse approach to AHU-IEI-v1-011 (the HA winners); their subjective ratings suggest that the background noise remained at an intrusive level, but the naturalness of the speech was preserved and intelligibility improved.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,MTEC-Approach2对AHU-IEI-v1-011(HA赢家)采取了反向方式;他们的主观评级表明背景噪音仍然处于侵入性水平,但演讲的自然性得以保留,隐形性得以提高.

blocks.en: In general, there is very little agreement between the objective metrics and subjective results, with all objective metrics offering vastly different rankings from what is seen in the subjective results. However, it should be noted that reference signals for live recordings, such as the CHiME-9 ECHI data, can be difficult to perfect, and so the mismatch may be related to the reference signals, as well as the metrics not quite being appropriate for conversational speech. These factors were the core of the motivation for evaluating the systems with subjective listening tests.
blocks.zh: 一般来说,客观的衡量标准与主观结果之间几乎没有什么一致,所有客观的衡量标准都提供了与主观结果所见大相径庭的排名. 然而,应该指出的是,用于现场录音的参考信号,如CHiME-9 ECHI数据,可能难以完善,因此不匹配可能与参考信号有关,而衡量标准也不太适合对话演讲. 这些因素是利用主观监听测试评估系统动机的核心。

blocks.en: It can also be seen that systems typically performed better on the Aria glasses than on the HA . This is most likely due to the inherent differences between the form factors of the devices. The Aria glasses have a comparatively fixed array geometry (subject to the arms of the glasses flexing), whereas the HA are worn on the ears, meaning the microphones are separated by human heads, which can vary greatly in size and shape. This variation can make it more difficult for multi-channel NN -techniques to learn inter-channel differences, leading to degraded NN performance.
blocks.zh: 也可以看到系统在Aria眼镜上的表现通常优于HA. 这很可能是由于设备形式因素之间的固有差异。 阿里亚眼镜具有相对固定的阵列几何(受眼镜的手臂摆动),而HA则佩戴在耳朵上,意思是麦克风被人头隔开,在大小和形状上可以有很大的差异. 这种变化可能使多渠道的NN-技术更难于学习跨渠道差异,导致NN性能退化.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: The CHiME-9 ECHI Challenge presents the task of enhancing the speech of conversation partners in noisy environments using recordings of real conversations in a simulated cafeteria-style environment. The challenge also evaluates submissions using both objective metrics and subjective listening tests of speech intelligibility and speech quality. Submissions varied greatly in how they approached the task, both from a technical and methodological approach, yielding improvements in all metrics over the challenge baseline, with the top systems making substantial gains in both the intelligibility and quality of the speech. These results are very encouraging for research into improving the experience of hearing-impaired listeners in social situations, and will hopefully promote future work in this field.
blocks.zh: CHIME-9 ECHI (英语). 挑战在于如何利用模拟食堂式环境中真实对话的录音,加强对话伙伴在吵闹环境中的发言。 这一挑战还利用客观的衡量尺度和主观的听力测试来评价提交材料的语音不通晓和语音质量。 从技术和方法角度而言,提交材料在如何完成任务方面差异很大,使所有衡量标准都比挑战基线有所改善,而顶层系统在发言的明晰性和质量方面都取得了巨大进展。 这些成果非常令人鼓舞,有助于研究如何改善听力障碍听众在社会状况中的经验,并有望促进这一领域的未来工作。
